title: Onomappu — 動物の鳴き声 (Animal Sounds in Japanese)
description: From Onomappu, a YouTube channel dedicated to Japanese onomatopoeia and sound words, taught entirely in Japanese by native speaker Hitoki (est. 2020). This episode covers animal sound words — how Japanese animals 'speak' differently from English. Cats say にゃーにゃー not meow; dogs say ワンワン not woof. Core N5 vocabulary with visual aids.
creator: Onomappu (Hitoki)
